scope: One-off outcome-neutral builder, validated only with temporary synthetic fixtures; not run against new or old real QA results.

opaque_content: actual QA stream bytes, decoded if gzip
input_contract.audit_summary_policy: Root must populate the small summary from the completed verified execution audit. It binds audit SHA, per-arm metrics/answer/actual stream hashes and audited flags/counts; retrieval must explicitly come from actual QA tool results at /workspace, not setup or CI success.

limitations: Does not grade or independently re-check source semantics/citations. It checks reviewer arithmetic/flag consistency and input identities.
Independent audit summary is an explicit trusted normalization of the full audit; the builder verifies its hashes and numeric consistency but does not infer an unknown audit schema.
A shared prompt and one observed pair cannot establish causal prompt effects or prove an internal self-check occurred.
Agent wall and measured grant/index/preflight setup are reported separately; no cold install/build total-speedup claim.
